_about: Richard Bentley (1662-1742), Master of Trinity College, Cambridge, the founder of modern classical criticism, raw IA OCR of The Works of Richard Bentley, D.D., collected and edited by the Rev. Alexander Dyce (London: Francis Macpherson, 1836-1838), 3 vols: I-II the Dissertation upon the Epistles of Phalaris (with the Epistola ad Millium, Latin, in vol. II), III his theological writings (the Boyle Lectures, Remarks upon a Discourse of Free-thinking, Proposals for an edition of the Greek Testament). The Epistles of Phalaris themselves are on the phalaris shelf; Jebb's life of Bentley (English Men of Letters) is on the jebb shelf. Not taken: The Correspondence of Richard Bentley (1842), mostly Latin letters, one volume of two on IA, OCR 0.74; his Latin editions of Horace, Terence and Manilius. Classical scholarship (lane B, round dy). No uids minted.
